newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee buyers focus on Brazils for 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee buyers focus on Brazils for 2nd half.

text.p: Futures gyrations after stunning rallies earlier this week put off German cash coffee buyers, apart from some demand for second half 1997 Brazils and Vietnamese robustas, traders said on Friday.
Arabica futures this week hit 20-year highs in some positions but were last sharply down in a corrective move.
The coffee industry was unprepared to pay high differentials for Colombians and Central American coffees, where physical prices were up $33-35 per 50 kg fob on the week.
Brazils were merely up $6 at $221 and Vietnamese robustas rose $13.50 to $92.50 cif.
